summary: BI-3E66F76F. Migration 20261027210000_agent_toolchain_converge_status adds the AgentToolchainConvergeStatus enum and three nullable AgentToolchainObservation columns recording how the host toolchain agent last fared, as each connection declares it in its converge token. Additive; no new model.
affectedCopies: AgentToolchainObservation.convergeStatus / convergeCode / convergeSince, written by recordToolchainObservation (apps/web/lib/agent-toolchain/connection-observation.ts) from the parsed converge token

Read by the fleet rollup (apps/web/lib/agent-toolchain/fleet-readiness.ts), the Connected Agent Clients card (apps/web/lib/agent-toolchain/connected-clients.ts) and the agent-toolchain attention source (apps/web/lib/attention/sources/agent-toolchain.ts)

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: internal: a closed status label, a machine reason code from a closed vocabulary, and a timestamp. Free text is dropped by the parser.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: The columns follow the observation row (operational drift telemetry, one row per credential).

migration.name: 20261027210000_agent_toolchain_converge_status
migration.backfill: None. Existing rows keep NULL, which every reader treats as no host-agent report (the agent predates the token or is not installed).
migration.rollback: Forward-only and additive. Older code never reads the columns.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Existing model; the columns follow the row.

fields.reason: Closed operational label (ok | failed | needs_operator | opted_out | offline | ahead_of_portal | busy) for the host agent's last completed run. Not a data-subject attribute.
fields.provenance: Parsed from the connection's converge token by parseConvergeToken; BI-3E66F76F.

fields.reason: Machine reason code for a failed or needs-operator run; anything that is not a short machine code is dropped.
fields.provenance: Parsed from the connection's converge token by parseConvergeToken; BI-3E66F76F.

fields.reason: When the host agent entered its current status; drives the 24-hour attention threshold.
